previous_assumption: Session linking would need an explicit session ID passed as a CLI argument
correction: Linking by most recent prediction file is sufficient and simpler — no argument needed, natural workflow emerges

previous_assumption: Contract validation would be a single pass/fail question per session
correction: Per-assertion validation with individual y/n/skip produces richer violation data. Each failed assertion gets its own log entry — contract-matcher can then surface 'violated 3 times' with specifics, not just 'violated'. Granularity makes future warnings actionable.
